rows.hook: Tata Communications reports modest revenue growth
rows.summary: Tata Communications reported standalone net sales of Rs 1,854.12 crore for the September 2026 quarter. This represents a 2.86% increase compared to the same period in the previous year. The figures reflect the company's standalone financial performance for the quarter.

rows.headline: India to build world's highest railway station in Ladakh
rows.hook: India plans world's highest railway station
rows.summary: The Indian government has announced a massive infrastructure project in Ladakh, estimated to cost ₹1.31 lakh crore. This initiative includes the construction of the world's highest railway station as part of a broader strategic connectivity push. The project aims to improve logistics and defense mobility in the high-altitude region. For retail investors, this signals long-term opportunities in infrastructure, construction, and engineering sectors involved in Himalayan development.
rows.why_it_matters: Long-term order book visibility for major Indian infrastructure and construction firms.

rows.headline: Google Photos changes how deleted items are handled
rows.hook: Google Photos updates automatic deletion policy
rows.summary: Google has updated its policy regarding the 'Trash' folder in Google Photos. Items moved to the trash will now be permanently deleted after 60 days if not manually restored. This change affects all users relying on the cloud service for long-term storage of deleted media. Users should verify their trash folders to prevent accidental permanent loss of important photos.
rows.why_it_matters: Users risk permanent loss of deleted photos if not checked regularly.

rows.headline: CNG prices hiked in Ahmedabad and other cities
rows.hook: CNG prices breach century mark in Ahmedabad
rows.summary: CNG prices in Ahmedabad have crossed the ₹100 per kilogram mark for the first time. The price hike has also been implemented across several other cities, impacting transport costs. This increase follows adjustments in the domestic natural gas allocation and pricing structure. Retail consumers and commercial vehicle operators will face higher daily commuting and logistics expenses.
rows.why_it_matters: Higher fuel costs increase household expenses and logistics inflation.
rows.winners_losers: Gas distributors gain / Commuters and logistics hurt

rows.headline: Centre plans to review new UGC regulations in Supreme Court
rows.hook: Supreme Court to review new UGC rules
rows.summary: The Central government has informed the Supreme Court that it intends to review the recently implemented University Grants Commission (UGC) rules. This follows legal challenges and concerns raised regarding the implementation of the new academic guidelines. The court is expected to oversee the process to ensure compliance with constitutional standards. For retail investors, this indicates potential policy volatility in the education sector, which may impact listed private education and coaching firms.
rows.whats_next: Next Supreme Court hearing on the matter
rows.why_it_matters: Policy shifts may impact private education and coaching stock valuations.

rows.headline: Recent market decline lacks broad participation
rows.hook: Market sell-off deepens but remains narrow
rows.summary: Financial Times analysis indicates that while equity markets are experiencing a significant sell-off, the decline is not yet widespread across all sectors. The concentration of the selling suggests that the broader market breadth remains relatively stable despite the headline index drops. This pattern indicates that specific segments are driving the volatility rather than a systemic market-wide collapse. Indian retail investors should note that concentrated selling often precedes either a sector rotation or a broader market correction.
rows.why_it_matters: Portfolio volatility may rise without a broad market crash

rows.headline: TDK Ventures president urges Indian deeptech to target global markets
rows.hook: Global potential for Indian deeptech startups
rows.summary: Nicolas Sauvage, President of TDK Ventures, advised Indian deeptech founders to build products for international markets from inception. He noted that India's challenging operating environment serves as a training ground for developing high-value capabilities. Founders are encouraged to leverage these local constraints to create solutions that are competitive globally. This perspective highlights the growing international interest in India's deeptech ecosystem.
rows.why_it_matters: Indian deeptech startups may attract more international venture capital funding.
